description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the MyAttendanceRecordAPI class, specifically testing its CRUD operations and associated workflow hooks within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It includes test methods for getAll, getOne, create, delete, and update, along with data providers and pre-hook configurations.

classes.name: MyAttendanceRecordAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for MyAttendanceRecordAPI, testing retrieval, creation, deletion, and updating of attendance records, along with enabling specific workflow hooks.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all attendance records with different parameters.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method, expects a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for 'getOne', expects a not implemented exception.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendancePreHook
methods.description: Enables workflow rules allowing users to modify attendance records in specific states by persisting workflow configuration.

methods.name: enableUserCanChangeCurrentTimePreHook
methods.description: Enables workflow rules allowing users to change current time in specific states by persisting workflow configuration.
